observation.command:
cd /workspace/.build-logs && pkill -f 'wave2.s[h]' 2>/dev/null; pkill -f 'docker buil[d]' 2>/dev/null; sleep 2
# Full transitive closure of shared services (any shared lib may pull another)
SHARED="03-shared-services/bizlog,03-shared-services/decision-protocol,03-shared-services/ki-logging,03-shared-services/ki-validierung,03-shared-services/prompt-loader,03-shared-services/prompt-security"
sed -i "s|\t03-shared-services/[^	]*$|\t$SHARED|" wave2.sh
# ensure demospipes bmds addons keep their own deps (they already do, no 03-shared match)
grep -c "$SHARED" wave2.sh
grep -P 'demospipes-bmds' wave2.sh
